title: Fix time-zone and DST bugs in the date helpers
prompt: Our booking app's date helpers in dates.js pass their tests on CI (which runs in UTC) but we keep getting bug reports from real users: people in California see bookings shown one day early, people in Japan say the week view starts on the wrong day and the 'nights' count is sometimes off by one, a customer in London was told their stay around the end of October ended a day early, and a night-shift worker was paid 3 hours for a 00:30-03:30 shift on the night the clocks went forward (it was really 2). All these functions deal with the user's LOCAL calendar and wall-clock time (the doc comments describe each one). Please fix dates.js so every function is correct in any time zone, including across daylight-saving changes. Keep the exported function names and signatures.
